meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Eos' Message
meta.description: I stand upon Magrasea, thinking of a future that has you in it.

units.rawText: Are you well? You put yourself at risk to help me in Eosphorus's neural space before. Any aftereffects?
units.displayText: Are you well? You put yourself at risk to help me in Eosphorus's neural space before. Any aftereffects?

spans.text: Are you well? You put yourself at risk to help me in Eosphorus's neural space before. Any aftereffects?

units.rawText: It is of no concern. Thanks to the assistance of you and those of the Reverse Babylon Tower, I can be whole again.
units.displayText: It is of no concern. Thanks to the assistance of you and those of the Reverse Babylon Tower, I can be whole again.

spans.text: It is of no concern. Thanks to the assistance of you and those of the Reverse Babylon Tower, I can be whole again.

units.rawText: I had thought that my duty as a phantom would come to an end that day, but a few little miracles came to be, so that we could meet again.
units.displayText: I had thought that my duty as a phantom would come to an end that day, but a few little miracles came to be, so that we could meet again.

spans.text: I had thought that my duty as a phantom would come to an end that day, but a few little miracles came to be, so that we could meet again.

units.rawText: In the way of repayment, after the battle with Eosphorus, I have given my all in establishing communications between the Oasis and other sectors alongside Angelus, for the sake of rebuilding Magrasea.
units.displayText: In the way of repayment, after the battle with Eosphorus, I have given my all in establishing communications between the Oasis and other sectors alongside Angelus, for the sake of rebuilding Magrasea.

spans.text: In the way of repayment, after the battle with Eosphorus, I have given my all in establishing communications between the Oasis and other sectors alongside Angelus, for the sake of rebuilding Magrasea.

units.rawText: Hehe, Angelus has been most impressive as the new head of the Sanctifiers. With her here, I can rest easy.
units.displayText: Hehe, Angelus has been most impressive as the new head of the Sanctifiers. With her here, I can rest easy.

spans.text: Hehe, Angelus has been most impressive as the new head of the Sanctifiers. With her here, I can rest easy.

units.rawText: That goes for you too, Professor. You need not be so busy from now on. Do not hesitate to rely upon me and Angelus if any difficulties arise.
units.displayText: That goes for you too, Professor. You need not be so busy from now on. Do not hesitate to rely upon me and Angelus if any difficulties arise.

spans.text: That goes for you too, Professor. You need not be so busy from now on. Do not hesitate to rely upon me and Angelus if any difficulties arise.

units.rawText: That about does it for public affairs. I've a mind to move onto affairs privy to only us.
units.displayText: That about does it for public affairs. I've a mind to move onto affairs privy to only us.

spans.text: That about does it for public affairs. I've a mind to move onto affairs privy to only us.

units.rawText: A stable bridge to reality has been established, and I am becoming more and more complete by the day thanks to your efforts.
units.displayText: A stable bridge to reality has been established, and I am becoming more and more complete by the day thanks to your efforts.

spans.text: A stable bridge to reality has been established, and I am becoming more and more complete by the day thanks to your efforts.

units.rawText: ...Professor, might I expect to be able to head to reality, and look forward to tomorrow by your side?
units.displayText: ...Professor, might I expect to be able to head to reality, and look forward to tomorrow by your side?

spans.text: ...Professor, might I expect to be able to head to reality, and look forward to tomorrow by your side?
